**T4: Menu Enhancement** - MenuItem Icon/Shortcut fields, Menu.Refresh() and MainMenu.Refresh() methods

**T5: Toolbar Enhancement** - ToolbarAction.SetIcon() method and concrete return types for toolbar factory functions

**T6: Container & Widget Enhancements** - Container.Add() nil-safe validation, RemoveAll(), Hyperlink.OnTapped callback, Entry.SetMinRowsVisible(), and data/validation/all.go with NewAllStrings()

**T7: Desktop System Tray** - driver/desktop/app.go with App interface containing SetSystemTrayMenu(), SystemTrayMenu(), and SetSystemTrayIcon()

```bash
go build ./...  # ✓ SUCCESS
go test ./...   # ✓ PASS (2 pre-existing failures in unrelated packages)
```
